Attempt the appropriate Language roll 
for each of the following books. For 
each successful roll, spend two hours 
and go to the pertinent entry:
• German, Die Mythe, go to 62.
• French, Cultes des Goules, go to 84.
• Latin, Liber lvonis, go to 140.
• English, Marvels of the Spirit 
World, go to 159.
When you have finished, go to 74.
